title: Tum Python kaynaklari derlenir (core + hat scriptleri)
Blender 4.5 headless baslar ve cleanup_mesh.py mevcut (3d-mesh-temizle)
Ortak cekirdek (core, core_3d) sozluk ve syntax hatasiz derlenir
verify: python -c "import py_compile, pathlib, sys; hata=[]; [hata.append(str(p)) for p in list(pathlib.Path('core').rglob('*.py'))+list(pathlib.Path('core_3d').rglob('*.py')) if not py_compile.compile(str(p), cfile=None, doraise=False)]; sys.exit(1 if hata else 0)"

title: Hat pipeline.json dosyalari gecerli JSON ve hat.ad dizin adiyla ayni
donergec-3d zincirinin her adiminin kapisi var (kapi kapsami %100 korunur)
verify: python -c "import json,sys; p=json.load(open('donergec-3d/configs/pipeline.json',encoding='utf-8')); z=p['zincir']; k=p.get('kapilar',{}); eksik=[a for a in z if not k.get(a)]; sys.exit(1 if eksik else 0)"

title: core dogrula denetiminde donergec-3d hattinda sorun yok
verify: python -c "import subprocess,sys,re; o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','core','dogrula'],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').stdout; blok=re.split(r'(?m)^(?=\\S)', o); d=[b for b in blok if b.startswith('donergec-3d')]; sys.exit(0 if d and 'SORUNLAR' not in d[0] else 1)"

title: Uslup sizmasi yok: prompt_suffix anahtarlari yalniz pipeline.json'un bilinen 4 yolunda
Tum sahne spec'leri gecerli JSON ve zorunlu alanlari tasiyor
verify: python -c "import json,pathlib,sys; kotu=[]; [kotu.append(str(f)) for f in pathlib.Path('donergec-3d/sahneler').glob('*.json') if not isinstance(json.load(open(f,encoding='utf-8')), dict)]; sys.exit(1 if kotu or not list(pathlib.Path('donergec-3d/sahneler').glob('*.json')) else 0)"

title: Trellis'i asan prop (kagit_yigini) devre disi kalir
verify: python -c "import json,sys; k=json.load(open('donergec-3d/configs/senaryo_kopru.json',encoding='utf-8')); import re; s=json.dumps(k,ensure_ascii=False); sys.exit(0 if '_devre_disi' in s and 'kagit_yigini' in s else 1)"
